id: 02_Safety Evaluation Test Questions & Answers (Officers) Safety Officer Test HSE ST
title: 安全知识抢答：二十道简答题（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/02_Safety Evaluation Test Questions & Answers (Officers) Safety Officer Test HSE ST.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/02_Safety Evaluation Test Questions & Answers (Officers) Safety Officer Test HSE ST（国内版）/src.py

points.K5: 有限空间作业的安全要求
points.S2: 校园有限空间与施工管理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在抢答台后，台上空白卡片朝下扣着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a stack of blank cards face down and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的安全抢答，不给选项！
overlay: 安全知识抢答：二十道简答题

shots.scene: 图标一排：氧气分子、井口、焊枪、事故表、梯子、护栏
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: an oxygen molecule, a manhole, a welding torch, a blank chart, a ladder and a guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧、有限空间、动火、事故、登高。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着空白卡片发愣，额头冒汗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at a blank question card and sweats nervously.
shots.narration: 阿杰慌了：没有选项，我该怎么答？

shots.scene: 小研递给他一个空白笔记本和笔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank notebook and a pen with a calm smile.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把想到的要点写下来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起空白题卡，没有ABCD选项
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank question card with no option boxes.
shots.narration: 二十道题，每题五分，八成及格。

shots.scene: 面试桌两侧坐着王老师和阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the young male student sit across a desk like an interview.
shots.narration: 就像面试，没人给你选项。

shots.scene: 阿杰在本子上写要点，旁边思考气泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes bullet points in a blank notebook with a thought bubble above his head.
shots.narration: 先在心里组织答案，记在本子上。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照答案卡打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares his notebook with an answer card and ticks items.
shots.narration: 最后再核对，看看答对了几题。

shots.scene: 一个空气圆饼图，一小块是氧气
shots.prompt_en: A simple pie chart of air with one slice highlighted by an oxygen molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：空气里的氧气占多少？

shots.scene: 其余大块标着氮气图标
shots.prompt_en: The larger part of the pie chart shows a nitrogen molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 大约百分之二十一，其余主要是氮气。

shots.scene: 氧气图标下降，一个人头晕的图标
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen icon with a downward arrow next to a dizzy head icon. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气一少，人就会头晕甚至昏倒。

shots.scene: 实验室里液氮罐和干冰箱放在小房间
shots.prompt_en: A small laboratory room with a liquid nitrogen dewar and a dry ice box. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，液氮和干冰会挤走氧气。

shots.scene: 墙上的氧含量报警器亮着
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen level monitor mounted on the wall with a green light. No people.
shots.narration: 用量大的房间要通风，装氧含量报警器。

shots.scene: 液氮罐放进密闭电梯的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a liquid nitrogen dewar riding alone in a closed elevator with a person beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人不和液氮罐同乘密闭电梯。

shots.scene: 报警器闪红灯，小研退出房间关门报告
shots.prompt_en: The oxygen monitor flashes red; the female graduate student steps out, closes the door and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 报警响了，先退出，再报告。

shots.scene: 一个地下水池的入口，风管伸进去
shots.prompt_en: An underground tank entrance with a large flexible air duct inserted into it from a blower. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：有限空间怎么保证通风？

shots.scene: 鼓风机送风、排风扇抽风，箭头循环
shots.prompt_en: A blower pushing fresh air in and an exhaust fan pulling air out, with circulating arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 用送风机送新鲜空气，用排风扇往外抽。

shots.scene: 纯氧气瓶对着井口的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oxygen cylinder blowing into a manhole, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万不能用纯氧通风，会助燃。

shots.scene: 焊接火花四溅的图标，周围空白
shots.prompt_en: A welding spark icon with scattered sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：焊接作业要准备什么？

shots.scene: 灭火器、防火毯、水带图标一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a fire extinguisher, a fire blanket and a coiled fire hose. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、防火毯、消防水带备在旁边。

shots.scene: 一名监火人站在焊工旁观察
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer welds wearing a face shield while the security officer stands nearby watching as fire watch.
shots.narration: 有经过培训的监火人全程看守。

shots.scene: 气体检测仪和洒水湿润地面的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a portable gas detector and a watering can wetting the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 先做气体检测，必要时把地面打湿。

shots.scene: 焊工戴面罩、手套、穿防护服
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a welding helmet, leather gloves and protective jacket.
shots.narration: 焊工穿戴好面罩、手套和防护服。

shots.scene: 实验楼走廊里老李拿着焊接设备，王老师拦住
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory building corridor, the safety administrator stops the facility engineer who carries welding equipment.
shots.narration: 实验楼里动火，必须先审批。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank permit form on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 清走附近的易燃试剂，关停相关气源。

shots.scene: 动火结束后，监火人留下检查余火
shots.prompt_en: After welding, the security officer stays and checks the area for smoldering embers with a flashlight.
shots.narration: 完工后还要留人检查，防止复燃。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 井口旁摆着空白许可证和检测仪
shots.prompt_en: A blank work permit and a gas detector placed beside an open manhole with a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：有限空间作业有哪些要求？
overlay: 有限空间作业的安全要求

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 许可证、检测仪图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A permit icon and a gas detector icon with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 先办作业许可，进入前做气体检测。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 井口外老李拿着空白登记表记录进出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands outside a manhole holding a blank entry log sheet as the attendant.
shots.narration: 外面有培训过的监护人，登记进出。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 全身式安全带、救生绳、三脚架、空气呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a full body harness, a lifeline, a rescue tripod and a self-contained breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 备好安全带、救生绳和空气呼吸器。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 气笛图标和步骤箭头：通风、检测、作业
shots.prompt_en: Three steps with arrows: a fan icon, a detector icon and a worker icon, plus a small air horn icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先通风、再检测、后作业，备好报警气笛。

shots.scene: 井内剖面图，几个危险图标漂浮
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a confined tank with floating hazard icons inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：有限空间有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 缺氧、骷髅、火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a low oxygen gauge, a skull and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧，有毒气体，可燃气体。

shots.scene: 湿滑台阶和昏暗灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a slippery step and a dim light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 还有湿滑绊倒和照明不良。

shots.section_title: 校园有限空间与施工管理
shots.scene: 校园里的污水井、管道井、地下水池
shots.prompt_en: On a university campus: a sewer manhole, a utility shaft door and an underground water tank hatch, all with warning signs. No people.
shots.narration: 校园里也有污水井、管道井和水池。
overlay: 校园有限空间与施工管理

shots.section_title: 校园有限空间与施工管理
shots.scene: 阿杰好奇地掀井盖，被保卫处值班员制止
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tries to lift a manhole cover out of curiosity; the security officer stops him.
shots.narration: 学生不得擅自进入有限空间。

shots.section_title: 校园有限空间与施工管理
shots.scene: 外来施工队在王老师处登记，出示空白资质卡
shots.prompt_en: An outside work crew registers with the safety administrator and shows blank qualification cards.
shots.narration: 外来施工要登记审批，按规定作业。

shots.scene: 一张空白表格，三栏图标：步骤、危害、措施
shots.prompt_en: A blank table with three column icons: footsteps, a hazard triangle and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：什么是JSA？

shots.scene: 作业被切成几个方块，一步一步
shots.prompt_en: A long task bar cut into several blocks with arrows between them. No people.
shots.narration: 把一项作业拆成一个个步骤。

shots.scene: 每个方块下方出现危害和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Under each block appear a hazard icon and a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 找出每步的危害，定好控制措施。

shots.scene: 老李把空白表格夹在许可证上，向工人讲解
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer clips the blank table to a work permit and explains it to two workers.
shots.narration: 附在作业许可上，开工前讲给每个人。

shots.scene: 五级台阶，从创可贴到黑色花圈图标
shots.prompt_en: Five rising steps with icons from a bandage, a medicine box, a restricted sign, a calendar with a cross, to a black ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：事故分哪几类？

shots.scene: 依次亮起前几级
shots.prompt_en: The first steps light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 急救、医疗处理、限制工作、损失工时、死亡。

shots.scene: 所有台阶旁的记录本打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank record book with a check mark beside every step. No people.
shots.narration: 每一类都要登记在案。

shots.scene: 国内事故等级图标，四级
shots.prompt_en: Four boxes increasing in size with warning icons. No people.
shots.narration: 国内还按伤亡和损失划分事故等级。

shots.scene: 小研手被划伤，贴创可贴后向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student with a small bandage on her finger reports to the older man in the lab.
shots.narration: 实验室里的小伤也要报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰差点碰倒试剂瓶，惊出一身汗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nearly knocks over a reagent bottle and catches it just in time, looking shocked.
shots.narration: 差点出事的未遂事件，同样要报。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白记录本上登记，画出改进箭头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes in a blank incident log and draws an improvement arrow.
shots.narration: 找出原因，改进措施，防止再发生。

shots.scene: 一个分数：上面伤害图标，下面时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction: an injury icon above the line and a clock icon below it. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：事故率怎么算？

shots.scene: 分子伤害数，分母总工时，乘一个固定基数
shots.prompt_en: A fraction with stacked injury icons on top, many clock icons on the bottom and a multiplier block. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害次数除以总工时，再乘统一基数。

shots.scene: 两个不同大小的工厂图标被放到同一把尺上比较
shots.prompt_en: Two factories of different sizes measured side by side on the same ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 这样大小单位才能放在一起比。

shots.scene: 分数：上面日历图标，下面时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction: a calendar icon above the line and a clock icon below. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：严重率怎么算？

shots.scene: 日历被撕掉几页，代表损失的工作日
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with several torn off pages. No people.
shots.narration: 损失的工作日除以总工时，乘同一基数。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白记录，旁边提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a blank statistics sheet with a small reminder icon.
shots.narration: 基数和统计口径，以现行标准为准。

shots.scene: 空白多页文件，封面化学瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank multi-page document with a chemical bottle icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：MSDS是什么？

shots.scene: 文件封面换成新版图标
shots.prompt_en: The document cover turns into a newer version with a shield and bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 物质安全数据表，现在通称SDS。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑上翻阅空白说明书页面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet on a computer screen.
shots.narration: 危害、防护、急救、泄漏处理都在里面。

shots.scene: 罐体里飘着一团灰色蒸气云
shots.prompt_en: A gray vapor cloud floating inside a tank cross-section. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：有限空间里的蒸气云怎么清？

shots.scene: 三个选项图标：火焰加热、泵、排风扇
shots.prompt_en: Three option icons: a heating flame, a pump and an exhaust fan. No people.
shots.narration: 加热？用泵？还是排风扇？

shots.scene: 排风扇亮起打勾，蒸气被抽出罐外
shots.prompt_en: The exhaust fan icon glows with a green check and the vapor is drawn out of the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 用排风扇抽走，加热反而危险。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的蒸气被向上抽走
shots.prompt_en: Vapor inside a laboratory fume hood being drawn upward into the exhaust duct. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室有挥发蒸气，就在通风柜里操作。

shots.scene: 井口里垂下一根照明灯线，闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A work lamp hanging down into a manhole with a lightning icon on the cable. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：有限空间用电有啥讲究？

shots.scene: 低电压电池图标配盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A low voltage battery icon with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 照明和手持工具，要用安全特低电压。

shots.scene: 王老师指着规程，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank rule book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体电压值，以现行标准和本单位规定为准。

shots.scene: 一条浓度刻度尺，左端低右端高
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal concentration scale from low to high with a flame icon zone in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：LEL是什么意思？

shots.scene: 刻度尺上火焰区的左边界亮起
shots.prompt_en: The left edge of the flame zone on the scale lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸下限：可燃气体能被点燃的最低浓度。

shots.scene: 检测仪读数远离下限，绿色
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector display showing a level far below the flame zone, in green. No people.
shots.narration: 检测读数要远低于下限才能作业。

shots.scene: 井下有人倒地，井口外监护人着急
shots.prompt_en: Outside a manhole, the facility engineer as attendant looks alarmed at a collapsed figure below.
shots.narration: 第十四题：监护人能下去救人吗？

shots.scene: 监护人往下跳的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the attendant climbing down into the manhole, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能！盲目下去，往往一起倒下。

shots.scene: 监护人吹气笛、打电话求援
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer blows an air horn and calls for help on a phone, staying outside the manhole.
shots.narration: 他要留在外面，报警，呼叫救援队。

shots.scene: 救援人员戴空气呼吸器，用三脚架和绳索施救
shots.prompt_en: Rescue workers wearing breathing apparatus use a tripod and rope at the manhole.
shots.narration: 由佩戴呼吸器的专业人员施救。

shots.scene: 厂区管道冒出气体，风向标转动
shots.prompt_en: A pipe leaking gas in an industrial area with a wind sock turning. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：气体泄漏，现场怎么办？

shots.scene: 停止作业的手掌图标，电闸图标打叉不碰
shots.prompt_en: A stop hand icon and a light switch icon with a warning not to touch. No people.
shots.narration: 立即停工，可燃气体时别开关电器。

shots.scene: 人群沿侧风箭头走向集合点
shots.prompt_en: Students walk along an arrow perpendicular to the wind toward an assembly point icon, upwind of the leak.
shots.narration: 看风向，往上风或侧风方向撤。

shots.scene: 集合点清点人数，同时打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: At the assembly point, the safety administrator counts people while making a phone call.
shots.narration: 到集合点清点人数，马上报告。

shots.scene: 一架木梯，刷漆的刷子图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wooden ladder with a paint brush icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六题：梯子能刷漆吗？

shots.scene: 放大镜照出梯子上的裂纹
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass reveals a crack on a ladder rung. No people.
shots.narration: 不能，油漆会盖住裂纹和缺陷。

shots.scene: 老李用前检查梯子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a ladder carefully before use.
shots.narration: 用梯子前，先看清有没有损坏。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在带轮转椅上够高处的试剂，画红叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands on a rolling office chair to reach a high shelf, with a red X over the scene.
shots.narration: 实验室取高处物品，不站转椅凳子。

shots.scene: 小研用稳固的人字梯，另一人扶梯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student climbs a sturdy step ladder while another student holds it steady.
shots.narration: 用合格的人字梯，有人扶稳。

shots.scene: 重试剂瓶放在低层架子
shots.prompt_en: Heavy reagent bottles placed on the lowest shelf of a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 重的、危险的试剂放低处。

shots.scene: 吊钩和吊带图标，下面一个重物
shots.prompt_en: A crane hook and a lifting sling holding a heavy block. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：什么是安全工作载荷？

shots.scene: 吊带上的空白标牌，砝码图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank tag on a lifting sling next to a weight icon. No people.
shots.narration: 吊具能安全承受的最大载荷。

shots.scene: 超重的箱子挂上吊带打叉
shots.prompt_en: An oversized block hanging from a thin sling, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超过标定载荷，坚决不吊。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰硬抬一只大气瓶，腰部红色疼痛图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over trying to lift a large gas cylinder; a red pain icon glows on his lower back.
shots.narration: 实验室搬气瓶、液氮罐，别硬抬。

shots.scene: 小研用气瓶推车固定运输
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves a gas cylinder strapped onto a cylinder trolley.
shots.narration: 用专用推车，固定好再走。

shots.scene: 小研蹲下靠近箱子，挺直背部抬起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student squats close to a box and lifts it with a straight back.
shots.narration: 抬箱子屈膝直背，贴近身体。

shots.scene: 两人合抬一个大箱子
shots.prompt_en: Two students carry a large box together.
shots.narration: 太重就两人合抬，或分批搬。

shots.scene: 地面被挖开一条沟槽
shots.prompt_en: A trench dug into the ground with soil piled beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十八题：什么是开挖？

shots.scene: 沟槽、坑、洞几个剖面图标
shots.prompt_en: Cross-section icons of a trench, a pit and a cavity in the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 挖走土方形成的沟、槽、坑、洞。

shots.scene: 沟边围挡和警示灯
shots.prompt_en: A trench surrounded by barriers and warning lights. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖现场要围挡，夜间设警示灯。

shots.scene: 三种土壤剖面：坚硬、中等、松散
shots.prompt_en: Three soil cross-sections side by side: hard compact soil, medium soil and loose crumbly soil. No people.
shots.narration: 第十九题：土壤分几类？

shots.scene: 松散土壤的沟壁塌落图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a loose soil trench wall collapsing. No people.
shots.narration: 原题按稳定性分三类，越松越易塌。

shots.scene: 空白勘察报告和边坡支护图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank geotechnical report and an icon of trench shoring. No people.
shots.narration: 国内按相关规范和勘察结论确定放坡支护。

shots.scene: 脚手架平台边缘的护栏：顶栏、中栏、挡脚板
shots.prompt_en: The edge of a scaffold platform with a guardrail: a top rail, a mid rail, a toe board and vertical posts. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十题：护栏系统由什么组成？

shots.scene: 人和工具被护栏挡住，不掉下去
shots.prompt_en: A person icon and a falling tool icon both stopped by the guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 顶栏、中栏、挡脚板和立柱。

shots.scene: 挡脚板挡住滚落的扳手
shots.prompt_en: A toe board stops a rolling wrench at the platform edge. No people.
shots.narration: 既防人坠落，也防物件掉落。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在几本空白法规书旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to several thick blank law books with a scale icon.
shots.narration: 国内有专门的法律管这些事。

shots.scene: 有限空间、缺氧、有毒气体图标与盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a confined space, low oxygen and toxic gas connected to a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间和缺氧作业，都有专门规定。

shots.scene: 三级台阶：学校、学院、实验室
shots.prompt_en: Three steps with icons: a university building, a faculty building and a laboratory flask. No people.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室三级落实责任。

shots.scene: 王老师合上规程书，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator closes a blank rule book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体条款，以现行文本和本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，白板上几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with several icons.
shots.narration: 抢答结束，回顾一下。

shots.scene: 通风、检测、作业三步图标，监护人图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a fan, a detector, a worker and an attendant outside a manhole. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间：先通风、再检测、后作业。

shots.scene: 打叉的跳井图标和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of jumping into a manhole crossed out, next to a phone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不盲目施救，先报警求援。

shots.scene: 动火审批、事故报告、推车、梯子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a signed permit, an incident log, a cylinder trolley and a step ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 动火审批、及时报告、科学搬运、用好梯子。

shots.scene: 阿杰合上写满要点的本子，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes a notebook full of bullet points and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：不给选项，我也能答了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside the quiz podium.
shots.narration: 先想后答，安全常记，下次见！
